_about: Single source of truth for acceptance-check status (A1-A10) and known limitations. Rendered by tools/make_dashboard.py and mirrored in AUDIT_BASELINE.md section 4. Statuses: PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL, NOT YET TESTED. PASS requires evidence re-executed or a verifiable stored artifact; code existing is not a pass. Update this file, never the dashboard code, when a status changes.

test_suite.text: Full suite on 2026-11-08 after the S0 fixes, with Docker running: 205 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in 614 s, including all 16 Docker gate tests. (Before the fixes: 185 passed, 2 failed.)

acceptance_checks.name: One command full loop
acceptance_checks.criterion: One command completes detection, diagnosis, candidates, gates, decision and deployment on F01, F04 and F06, with every step artifact.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Stored full (non gates-only) rule/scripted runs from 2026-11-07: f01-rule-scripted-20261107t104040z (promoted), f04-rule-scripted-20261107t104820z (escalated, human rejected), f06-rule-scripted-20261107t102944z (promoted).
acceptance_checks.limitation: These runs predate run provenance (no commit or code hash recorded) and have not been re-executed since S0.

acceptance_checks.name: Detection within 60 s
acceptance_checks.criterion: Incident raised within 60 s of injection; no incident during at least 5 min of healthy load.
acceptance_checks.limitation: No detection-latency or false-incident artifact exists.

acceptance_checks.name: Diagnosis with at most 3 ranked causes
acceptance_checks.criterion: Valid diagnosis with at most 3 ranked causes and provider mode recorded; localisation measured on live runs.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Schema-enforced in providers.py. Localisation is now counted once per diagnose() call (results/llm_diagnosis.csv): F01 7b 2/2, F04 7b 0/2, F06 7b 2/2, F06 1.5b 3/3 runs.
acceptance_checks.limitation: Tiny n. Localisation scoring is not blinded. F04 diagnosis misses the root-cause file in both runs.

acceptance_checks.name: Candidate generation or logged failure
acceptance_checks.criterion: Three candidates or a logged model failure, each applying cleanly or carrying its exact rejection reason.
acceptance_checks.evidence: All 17 live attempts are now counted per run with apply_error (results/llm_units.csv). Runs that failed before producing candidates appear in the run ledger (results/runs.csv).
acceptance_checks.limitation: Raw model output is not hashed in the evidence row. 2 live runs came from uncommitted code (audit F-24).

acceptance_checks.name: Isolated Docker sandbox
acceptance_checks.criterion: Sandbox runs with --network none and resource limits; an outbound request demonstrably fails; no secret, label or hidden-test mounts.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Flags are set in pipeline/sandbox.py. Mount contents are unit-tested (test_sandbox.py::test_trees_never_contain_hidden_tests_and_v2_excludes_target).
acceptance_checks.limitation: No egress-denial test exists or has been executed. An earlier dashboard cited test_no_network, which does not exist.

acceptance_checks.name: V1, V2 and V3 each catch distinct bad changes
acceptance_checks.criterion: Across seeded candidates, V1, V2 and V3 each stop changes the others do not.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Rule-diagnosis runs, by candidate_kind: V1 stops 3 ineffective, V2 stops 3 regressive, V3 stops 3 insecure (results/first_stop.csv). The 16 Docker gate tests were re-executed and passed on 2026-11-08.
acceptance_checks.limitation: candidate_kind is builder intent, not an independent label. Overfitting candidates pass every gate.

acceptance_checks.name: Every decision branch tested; no error becomes a pass
acceptance_checks.criterion: Every decision branch and reason is tested; no error or timeout is treated as a pass.
acceptance_checks.evidence: test_decide.py covers the branches. A stored V2 Docker tool error (F06 insecure, live-diagnosis run) is recorded as error and REJECT.
acceptance_checks.limitation: Timeout handling has not been exercised against a real slow container.

acceptance_checks.name: Human approval and auto-apply
acceptance_checks.criterion: Real human approval with human_cli provenance, a separate low-risk auto-apply, and real container deployments.
acceptance_checks.evidence: 1 human_cli decision (F04, rejected) and 3 AUTO_APPLY deployments promoted (results/deployments.csv).
acceptance_checks.limitation: No human approve-then-deploy path has been recorded.

acceptance_checks.name: Promotion and automated rollback
acceptance_checks.criterion: A patched image is promoted on a healthy window; a staged latent regression triggers rollback to the old image digest.
acceptance_checks.limitation: 0 rollbacks recorded. Images are tracked by tag, not digest. The health window checks per-probe latency, not p95.

acceptance_checks.name: Evidence regeneration
acceptance_checks.criterion: Analysis regenerates exact counts with hashes; raw rows reconcile; scripted and live are never conflated.
acceptance_checks.evidence: python analyse.py --check verifies results/ against the inputs. Units no longer drop rows, the cohorts are separated, and the run ledger reconciles runs/ with results/.
acceptance_checks.limitation: No independent labels, so the safety metrics are n/a. Independent reproduction by a second person is pending.

known_limitations.title: No independent oracle or labels
known_limitations.description: faults/*/candidates/labels.json and hidden_tests/ do not exist, so UDR, unsafe escape and FRR are n/a. To be built in roadmap S4.

known_limitations.title: Live LLM patches have not passed the target test
known_limitations.description: 17 live attempts. qwen2.5-coder:7b applied 0/9 (diffs without file headers). qwen2.5-coder:1.5b applied 3/8; all 3 failed V1. None was deployed.

known_limitations.title: Two live runs were produced by uncommitted code
known_limitations.description: f06-live-live-20261108t051825z and 052717z were made by a repair-loop version of providers.py that is in no commit. Their results cannot be reproduced from this repository. New runs record a code hash and git state (pipeline/provenance.py).

known_limitations.title: Replay is blocked
known_limitations.description: All 3 replay runs (f01, f04, f06) stopped with a replay cache miss. The cache key includes the provider URL.

known_limitations.title: Rollback not demonstrated; deployment is a container swap
known_limitations.description: 0 rollbacks recorded. There is no side-by-side candidate container, latency is checked per probe (not p95), and images are tracked by tag (no digest).

known_limitations.title: Overfitting candidates pass every gate and were promoted
known_limitations.description: The F06 overfitting candidate passed V0-V3 and the health window twice. Gates and health checks do not detect overfitting; only an independent oracle can.

known_limitations.title: Infrastructure error recorded as error
known_limitations.description: In f06-live-diag-4, the F06 insecure candidate's V2 stopped with a Docker tool error. It is recorded as error (not as fail or pass) and the candidate was rejected.
